tagline: Planned: a technical passport of a project that can be stored and used to rebuild and audit it.
description: EH3D-PROJECT-PASSPORT is planned as a generator of a storable, reproducible technical passport to audit a whole project. Today it has the base of every repository of the suite and a written scope, requirements and dependencies; no code has been written and nothing has been run on a machine.
